QUOTE: The entry is split at the first `:`. The left part must match the tool name. - With no colon, the entry matches the tool on any arguments. `git.commit` allows every `git.commit` call.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names plain fnmatch, the split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a colon-less pattern matches on the tool name alone.
